problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of f(x)=‖A(x−xstar)‖²/2 on a real Hilbert space; f(xstar)=0.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuadraticTemporalDiscrepancy.lean: Instance, objective, spec.Query, spec.Output; LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public.

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: The operator bounds μ‖v‖²≤‖Av‖²≤L‖v‖² imply μ-strong convexity and L-Lipschitz continuity of the gradient A* A(x−xstar). Parameters satisfy 0<μ≤L, D≥0, Δ≥0, ε>0, and f(x0)≤Δ.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Quadratic objectives with a bounded linear operator A and hidden minimizer xstar; no finite-dimensional restriction is imposed.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: Each call k at x returns A* A(x−xstar)+e_k. The additive error is independent of the query and oracle seed. Only gradient vectors are supplied. E, L, μ and x0 are public; D, Δ and ε determine the evaluation budget but are not algorithm inputs. A, xstar and the error sequence are hidden. Oracle cost is a fixed number of sequential calls.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuadraticTemporalDiscrepancy.lean: Public, Params, Instance, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: Errors may be arbitrary nonzero deterministic offsets subject to the cumulative discrepancy bound; no zero-mean condition is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuadraticTemporalDiscrepancy.lean: spec.admissible, equality quantified over every k, x and seed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: temporal_discrepancy
distinctive_assumptions.details: There exists one error sequence satisfying ‖Σ_{k=0}^{n−1}e_k‖≤D for every n. This controls signed cumulative errors, without requiring individual errors to decay, independence, unbiasedness, or a Markov model.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap requirement holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law after the prescribed fixed call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Strongly convex quadratic minimization is classical, but the query-independent additive oracle errors with uniformly bounded signed cumulative sums constitute an unusual temporal error model.
